purpose: Literature coverage contract for model-health diagnosis and repair. Each row is a source paper, not a claim that the repository reproduces every method on every architecture.

papers.title: Evaluating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
Mitigating Object Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models through Visual Contrastive Decoding
papers.execution: released tensor-space corruption, plausibility cutoff, and per-token multinomial sampler; diffusion noise is seeded per image so frozen validation is order-independent

papers.title: OPERA: Alleviating Hallucination in Multi-Modal Large Language Models via Over-Trust Penalty and Retrospection-Allocation
Paying More Attention to Image: A Training-free Method for Alleviating Hallucination in LVLMs
papers.execution: LLaVA eager-attention implementation of the released image-score boost and image-free classifier-free-guidance cache; it remains a native architecture specialization because the source pins a different LLaVA stack

papers.title: V*: Guided Visual Search as a Core Mechanism in Multimodal LLMs
papers.execution: label-free visual-search method-family control; official trained SEAL remains separate

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models with Instruction Contrastive Decoding
papers.execution: architecture-native Q-Former disturbance on InstructBLIP, evaluated as a deterministic binary specialization; decoder-input adaptation on Q-Former-free hf_local VLMs is separately labelled adapted

papers.title: ChartQA: A Benchmark for Question Answering about Charts with Visual and Logical Reasoning
MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI
HALLUCINOGEN: A Benchmark for Evaluating Object Hallucination in Large Visual-Language Models
MLLMs Know Where to Look: Training-free Perception of Small Visual Details with Multimodal LLMs
papers.execution: LLaVA relative-attention ViCrop is an automated L3a FixAgent route with original+crop input; architecture-mismatched models remain explicitly adapted/unavailable

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models with Internal Fact-based Contrastive Decoding
DyFo: A Training-Free Dynamic Focus Visual Search for Enhancing LMMs in Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
papers.execution: black-box MCTS over focus regions: the LMM and external grounding/segmentation experts propose and score zoomed sub-views, answers aggregated by voting; runnable end-to-end against a chat endpoint plus local expert tools

papers.title: Divide, Conquer and Combine: A Training-Free Framework for High-Resolution Image Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.execution: black-box divide (recursive patching) / conquer (per-patch description) / combine (aggregated descriptions plus full image re-ask) loop; pure crop-and-chat, no model internals

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Perception: High-Resolution Image Perception Meets Visual RAG
papers.execution: external retriever scores query-relevant crops, a spatial-awareness layout re-assembles them, and Retrieved-Exploration Search adaptively picks the crop count; the exact RE-Search confidence signal wants token logprobs — a verbalized-confidence substitute must be labelled adapted

papers.title: API: Attention Prompting on Image for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.execution: an auxiliary CLIP/LLaVA model computes a text-query-conditioned attention heatmap that is overlaid as a soft mask on the input image before querying the target VLM; the target stays black-box — the overlay counterpart of ViCrop's crop

papers.title: Compositional Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Large Multimodal Models
papers.execution: prompt-only two-step scaffold: generate a scene graph for image plus question, then answer with the scene graph in context; also serves as a discriminant-validity control — it should not win on perception-limited slices
